copy.title: Shieldx Locksmiths — Official Site | Find Your Local Branch
copy.description: The official home of the Shieldx Locksmiths branch network. Nine local branches on a genuine 24-hour rota — from Boston and Peterborough to Hastings and Westhoughton. Find your branch and call direct.
copy.topbar: Every Shieldx branch runs a genuine 24-hour rota — nights, weekends and bank holidays
copy.h1: There's always a Shieldx awake near you
copy.lead: Shieldx Locksmiths is a network of nine local branches built around one promise: someone answers, someone attends, whatever the hour. From the Lincolnshire fens to the Sussex coast, each branch is run by locksmiths who live and work in the town they cover.
copy.heroNote: {n} branches, one standard: answered calls and attended jobs, 24 hours a day.

coverage.heading: Nine branches, nine towns that never get left waiting
coverage.intro: Each Shieldx branch keeps its own local number and its own overnight rota. Pick your town to go straight to your branch's site — the areas listed are where that team is out working every week.
coverage.areaPattern: On call across {areas} and every corner of {town}

services.heading: Built for the calls that can't wait
services.intro: Every branch carries the same emergency kit and works to the same response standard — these are the jobs the overnight rota exists for, alongside the full range of planned work.
featured: The core of what Shieldx is: a locksmith on the road to you at 3am, not an answering machine.
Non-destructive entry as the default — picked, not drilled, wherever the lock allows it.
Post-break-in make-safe the same night, with locks brought back to insurance standard.
Doors and windows secured within hours of the damage, day or night.
Snapped keys extracted without sacrificing the cylinder, usually same visit.
Lost keys or a new tenancy — cylinders and full locks swapped on the spot.

why.heading: What holds the network together
points: "24/7" is easy to print on a van. Every Shieldx branch actually staffs its overnight shift, and the branch phone is answered by the person who'll attend.
The engineer who turns up knows the estates, terraces and new-builds of their own town — because it's the only town they cover.
From Boston to Sompting, the same vetting, the same non-destructive-first approach, the same upfront pricing before any work starts.
Emergency work is finished to BS3621 / TS007 standard, so a bad night doesn't turn into a rejected claim.

cta.heading: Need a locksmith right now?
cta.sub: Your nearest Shieldx branch is on shift. Find it below and call the local number direct.

copy.footerBlurb: The official site of the Shieldx Locksmiths branch network — nine local branches running genuine 24-hour rotas across England.
